title: Renew a combatant registration
summary: You can apply online to renew your combat sports combatant registration to participate in combat sport contests in NSW.
intro:
You can apply online to renew your combat sports combatant registration to engage in combat sport contests in NSW. This can be done online from 8 weeks before your registration expiry date.

Registration expires 3 years from the date granted, unless cancelled earlier, or the term extended or reduced.
who_can_apply: You must have submitted a complete application and your registration must not have expired.
You must not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account (you can create one when applying).
Your renewal number (including all digits and letters, as shown on your renewal reminder notice).
A recent passport size photograph in JPG/PNG format (maximum file size 10MB).
Proof of successful completion of training relating to the management of concussions and head injuries.

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Enter your registration and renewal numbers, these can be found on your renewal notice
Follow the prompts to apply for combat sports combatant registration.

more_info.text: You will not get a medical record book as you've previously been registered as a combatant with the Combat Sports Authority of NSW. You should continue using the medical record book that was issued to you when you first registered.
If you need to update your details, go to Change name or contact details on a combatant registration.

You can only renew combatant class(es) already held on your registration. We recommend completing a Manage combatant classes transaction after your renewal application is approved if you need to update your registration classes.
To check your combatant registration number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How long is a combatant registration valid for?
faqs.a: A registration is valid for 3 years from the date it was granted, unless it is cancelled or the term is extended or reduced.

faqs.q: When can I renew my combatant registration?
faqs.a: You can apply online to renew your registration starting 8 weeks before the expiry date.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to renew their combatant registration?
faqs.a: You can renew if you have submitted a complete application and your registration has not expired. You must also not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.
